intent: Improve passive solar shading: require explicit current sunny/partlycloudy Home Assistant weather before auto-closing; automatically open only shades proven closed by this integration; permanently respect a user's subsequent manual opening unless room shading is explicitly disabled/re-enabled; add Home device global opt-in to announce before physically opening or closing shades.
note: Physical shutter identity and source state checked at every transition; record ownership intent before service, confirm actual closed/open with strict acknowledgement timeout, migrate beta43 stored attempts conservatively without claiming ownership. Pre-notice uses existing Hub or HA notifications/TTS and fails closed if unavailable, with post-announcement revalidation. Preserve all PID/room controls and single environment_manager domain.
changes: Evaluate only the configured Home Assistant weather entities and documented condition states; permit closing in sunny/partlycloudy, never in cloudy/rain/fog/wind/severe or unavailable/stale/conflicting weather, with room temperature, sun angle and selected window contacts still required.
Add per-cover persisted lifecycle closing_requested -> confirmed owned_closed -> opening_requested -> released; a successful close_cover service acknowledgement by itself does not grant ownership.

Auto-open only a still-closed, exactly selected and previously confirmed owned shade after sunset/low sun or sustained benign cloudy weather/room cooling; never open a user-closed shade, or an unconfirmed beta43 legacy close attempt.

Treat an observed manual opening of an owned shade as durable manual_override. Never fight its reopening or automatically close that shade again merely because cooldown expires; allow explicit re-authorization by turning the room shade switch OFF then ON.

Halt movement on missing/unsafe weather or windows, unknown or mismatched source, unsupported OPEN/CLOSE native capability, changed control revision, user intervention or persistence failure; check again after announcement and after saving intent.

Home-wide shade_announce_before_movement switch on Home device, off by default, with all 38 translated names; localized Greek/English/German/French/Spanish pre-movement notice with room and direction.

Submit pre-movement notices through the configured Announcement Hub or native room-specific HA notify/TTS with visual fallback. Do not move if announced delivery was not accepted. Wait a short grace interval and revalidate all controls before physical action.

Retain b43 opt-in room cover selectors/sun temperature controls, independent 30-second shade evaluation, existing physical HVAC/PID permissions and beta42 PID-first 38-language labels; no migration or duplicate integration.
Gate on Python 3.13/3.14 suite including b43 and b44 weather/manual/ownership/delivery cases, Node card, real HA 2026.10, HACS/Hassfest, translated catalogs and exact immutable flat HACS prerelease.
